short_hike:
UNCONFIRMED. No primary source I reached names A Short Hike's in-game typeface.
- The Soreine/A-Short-Hike-Translations README names no font.
- Two web searches found nothing.
- One search summary claimed "Cardenio Modern". That is the font of the adamgryu.com website, not shown to be used in the game, so I reject it as the game font.

I did not re-read the finder's other claims (Unity; the PlayStation Blog render notes; per-script font sizes in the Steam fan-translation post), so they are carried over, not re-verified. The target look ("chunky pixel-style sans") is the finder's recollection, not a sourced fact.

Method notes:
- One Google Fonts CSS API request listed all 11 finder family strings with their weight ranges. It returned valid CSS with no error, so every css_family below is accepted as written.
- Subsets come from google/fonts METADATA.pb. Licence and RFN come from google/fonts OFL.txt.
- No font file was opened, so no glyph claim is confirmed.

Full notes: C:\Users\xperi\AppData\Local\Temp\claude\D--prime-game\ce8374ce-5cfc-424c-bd40-f671bc77f06b\scratchpad\fonts\verified.md

fonts.name: Tiny5
fonts.why: Minimal 5 px pixel sans, clean and unfussy. Good for HUD counters, the stamina label and short tags. Too small for long text.
fonts.licence: SIL OFL 1.1 (METADATA.pb license "OFL"; OFL.txt "SIL OPEN FONT LICENSE Version 1.1 - 26 February 2007")
fonts.rfn: none. Copyright line: "Copyright 2022-2024 The Tiny5 Project Authors (https://github.com/Gissio/font_tiny5)".
fonts.cyrillic: Verified in METADATA.pb: cyrillic and cyrillic-ext (also greek, latin, latin-ext).
fonts.ukrainian_glyphs: Unconfirmed, but the strongest indirect evidence of any pixel font here. The upstream README (Gissio/font_tiny5) claims Latin, Greek, Cyrillic and Armenian, '974 languages' and '1,942 glyphs'. Ukrainian is not named. U+02BC and U+2019 unconfirmed.
fonts.notes: STATUS: VERIFIED (licence, RFN, subsets, CSS). Designer Stefan Schmidt, added 2024-04-19, category SANS_SERIF with classification DISPLAY, single weight 400. The README mentions Armenian, but the Google Fonts build has no armenian subset, so the README may describe a newer upstream than the Google Fonts binary (commit 1d6e16f).

fonts.name: Pixelify Sans
fonts.why: Friendly pixel sans with readable lowercase and a variable weight. It is the closest stylistic guess at a chunky but readable low-res game font.
fonts.licence: SIL OFL 1.1 (METADATA.pb license "OFL"; OFL.txt version 1.1, 26 February 2007)
fonts.rfn: none. Copyright line: "Copyright 2021 The Pixelify Sans Project Authors (https://github.com/eifetx/Pixelify-Sans)".
fonts.cyrillic: Verified in METADATA.pb: cyrillic only, NO cyrillic-ext (also latin, latin-ext).
fonts.ukrainian_glyphs:
Unconfirmed.
- The upstream README says nothing about scripts.
- I fetched sources/PixelifySans.glyphs; it was cut off in the Latin range, so the check is inconclusive.
- Only third-party aggregator sites (seen in search snippets) claim ґ support. That is not a primary source.
- U+02BC and U+2019 unconfirmed.
fonts.notes: STATUS: VERIFIED (licence, RFN, subsets, CSS); glyphs at risk. Designer Stefie Justprince, added 2023-09-13, DISPLAY, wght axis 400-700. Source eifetx/Pixelify-Sans @39df74a. A search result points to a type.today review of Cyrillic on Google Fonts that questions its Cyrillic design. I did not read it. Run a local glyph check before choosing.

fonts.rfn: Press Start 2P. Copyright line: "Copyright 2012 The Press Start 2P Project Authors (cody@zone38.net), with Reserved Font Name "Press Start 2P"."
fonts.cyrillic: Verified in METADATA.pb: cyrillic and cyrillic-ext (also greek, latin, latin-ext).

fonts.notes: STATUS: VERIFIED. Designer CodeMan38, added 2012-04-04, DISPLAY, single weight 400. Source: googlefontdirectory-hg. Because of the RFN, ship the file unmodified; a subset or edited copy must be renamed.

fonts.name: Handjet
fonts.why: Modular pixel-grid face. Its ELSH axis turns the elements from round to square, so the pixels can be soft and rounded: a low-res look that is still clean.
fonts.rfn: none. Copyright line: "Copyright 2018 The Handjet Project Authors (https://github.com/rosettatype/Handjet/)".
fonts.cyrillic: Verified in METADATA.pb: cyrillic and cyrillic-ext (also arabic, armenian, greek, hebrew, latin, latin-ext, vietnamese).
fonts.ukrainian_glyphs: Unconfirmed. The upstream README (rosettatype/handjet) lists the scripts Arabic, Armenian, Cyrillic, Greek, Hebrew, Latin and Korean, but does not name Ukrainian. U+02BC and U+2019 unconfirmed.
fonts.notes: STATUS: VERIFIED. By Rosetta and David Březina, added 2020-09-11, DISPLAY. Axes: wght 100-900, ELSH 0-16 (default 2), ELGR 1-2. The CSS string requests weight only. Condensed letters.

fonts.cyrillic: Verified in METADATA.pb: cyrillic and cyrillic-ext (also hebrew, latin, latin-ext).

fonts.notes: STATUS: VERIFIED, with one correction. By NaN and Luke Prowse, added 2022-11-25, DISPLAY. The finder said 'single heavy weight'; it looks heavy, but its registered weight is 400. Display sizes only.

fonts.name: M PLUS Rounded 1c
fonts.why: Soft rounded sans with a gentle game-UI feel: some retro softness without pixels.
fonts.licence: OFL according to METADATA.pb only. There is NO licence file in google/fonts/ofl/mplusrounded1c: the GitHub API listing shows only METADATA.pb, 7 TTFs and upstream_info.md, which explains the finder's 404.
fonts.rfn: None stated. The METADATA.pb copyright string is "Copyright 2016 The Rounded M+ Project Authors." with no RFN clause. There is no OFL.txt to confirm.
fonts.cyrillic: Verified in METADATA.pb: cyrillic and cyrillic-ext (also greek, greek-ext, hebrew, japanese, latin, latin-ext, vietnamese). Primary script Jpan.
fonts.ukrainian_glyphs: Unconfirmed: only the subset tags are known. Moderate risk for a Japanese family. U+02BC and U+2019 unconfirmed.
fonts.notes:
STATUS: CAUTION, licence paperwork incomplete.
- upstream_info.md matches the upstream coz-m/MPLUS_FONTS with LOW confidence; that repo may not contain the Rounded variant. The binary was re-added on 2025-04-10 in a 'Missing in GH' fix.
- coz-m/MPLUS_FONTS has an OFL 1.1 file, but its copyright holder ('Copyright 2021 The M+ FONTS Project Authors') differs from the Rounded binary's.
- The font's embedded licence field is unchecked.
- Usable only if we bundle our own OFL 1.1 text with the 2016 Rounded M+ copyright line. Prefer Nunito, Rubik or Golos Text.

dropped: DotGothic16: soft drop. The licence passes (SIL OFL 1.1, no RFN, METADATA.pb subsets cyrillic, japanese, latin, latin-ext, CSS 'DotGothic16'), but the evidence suggests no Ukrainian letters. The upstream README (github.com/fontworks-fonts/DotGothic16) states its coverage as 'All glyphs in Adobe-Japan1-3' plus 'GF Latin Core'. Adobe-Japan1's Cyrillic comes from JIS X 0208 row 7, which per Wikipedia is 'the modern Russian alphabet' (66 letters), without ґ є і ї. The letters are likely missing, not proven missing; re-add the font only if a local glyph check shows ґ є і ї.
A Short Hike 'Cardenio Modern' (from a web-search summary): rejected as the game's font. It is the adamgryu.com website font, and nothing shows it is used in the game.
